subject: general
question: Name the entity that has launched the 'Waste to Wealth Creation' programme tor women in the Sundarbans in the west Bengal?

options.text: Ministry of Women and Child Development
Ministry of health and family welfare
Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI)**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI)** has launched the '**Waste to Wealth Creation**' programme for women in the Sundarbans in West Bengal.
 
• This initiative aims to **empower women** by providing them with opportunities to create sustainable income through waste management and recycling activities.
 
• Sundarbans, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, is known for its unique biodiversity and the programme seeks to address environmental concerns while promoting economic development.
 
• The programme is expected to enhance the livelihoods of women by involving them in the production of eco-friendly products from waste materials.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **SIDBI** was established in **1990 **and is headquartered in** Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh**.
 
• It serves as the principal financial institution for the promotion, financing, and development of the Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprise (MSME) sector in India.
 
• The bank provides various financial and non-financial services to support the growth and development of MSMEs across the country.
 
• SIDBI also plays a crucial role in implementing government schemes aimed at fostering entrepreneurship and innovation in the MSME sector.
